cases.name: owner
notices: accepted by the owner (solo mode; no independent review): workorder-allow:TASK-2 added by the pull request author, the repository owner
accepted by the owner (solo mode; no independent review): workorder-allow:no-task added by the pull request author, the repository owner

cases.name: owner, permission lookup failed
notices: accepted by the owner (solo mode; no independent review): workorder-allow:TASK-2 added by the pull request author, the repository owner
accepted by the owner (solo mode; no independent review): workorder-allow:no-task added by the pull request author, the repository owner

accepted by the owner (solo mode; no independent review): workorder-allow:no-task added by the pull request author, an admin of the repository
